# The Foot Studio Podiatry

> Family and sports podiatry clinic in Claremont, Western Australia. Pain and movement, skin and nails, and Beauty & Relaxation (podiatry-designed manicures and pedicures by our nail therapists), with an onsite gym, a Zebris pressure mapping treadmill and a shoe and movement shop.

- Address: Level 1, 216 Stirling Highway, Claremont WA 6010
- Phone: (08) 9280 0223
- Email: hello@thefootstudio.com.au
- Book online: https://the-foot-studio.au1.cliniko.com/bookings
- Hours: Monday 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Tuesday 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Wednesday 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Thursday 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Friday 7:00 AM to 2:30 PM; Saturday closed; Sunday closed
- No referral needed. GP Chronic Condition Management (Medicare) referrals accepted. Self-managed and plan-managed NDIS participants welcome.

## Services
- [Ingrown Toenails](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/ingrown-toenail-treatment): Ingrown toenail care in Claremont, from conservative treatment and nail bracing to nail surgery under local anaesthetic. Adults and kids. No referral needed.
- [Custom Orthotics](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/orthotics): Custom foot orthoses in Claremont, designed by podiatrists after a full assessment, gait analysis and 3D foot scan. Footwear, exercises and reviews included in your plan. No referral needed.
- [EXO-L Ankle Brace](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/exo-l-ankle-brace): Custom EXO-L and EXO-L UP ankle braces in Claremont, made from a 3D scan of your ankle. For ankle instability, sport and foot drop. No referral needed.
- [Kids Podiatry](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/childrens-podiatry): Children's podiatry in Claremont for flat feet, toe walking, in-toeing, heel pain, clumsiness, ingrown nails and warts. No referral needed.
- [Heel Pain](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/heel-pain-treatment): Heel pain and plantar fasciitis assessment and treatment in Claremont: education, loading programs, footwear, shockwave, laser and orthotics where appropriate. No referral needed.
- [Chronic Pain](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/chronic-pain): Podiatry for chronic and persistent foot, ankle and leg pain in Claremont. Pain education, graded movement, footwear and treatment options in a plan built around you. No referral needed.
- [Fungal Nails](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/fungal-nail-treatment): Fungal nail assessment and treatment in Claremont: nail care, in-clinic testing, topical treatment and Lunula laser. No referral needed.
- [Diabetes Foot Care](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/diabetes-foot-care): Diabetes neurovascular foot assessments in Claremont: nerve and circulation checks, toe pressures, skin and nail care and a personalised action plan. Medicare CCM referrals accepted.
- [Running Injuries](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/running-and-trail-running): Podiatry for runners and trail runners in Claremont: running assessment, ankle strength, blisters and toenails, footwear, orthotics and return to run.
- [Cracked Heels](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/cracked-heels): Dry, cracked and painful heels treated by podiatrists in Claremont. Hard skin removal, skin care and footwear advice to help stop cracks returning.
- [Shockwave Therapy](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/shockwave): Radial shockwave therapy in Claremont for longer-standing heel, Achilles and tendon pain, given by podiatrists as part of a full treatment plan.
- [Healthy Ageing](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/healthy-ageing-podiatry): Podiatry for older adults in Claremont: toenail and skin care, arthritis, balance and falls, footwear and staying active. Medicare CCM referrals accepted.
- [Richie Brace](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/richie-brace-afo): Custom Richie Brace ankle foot orthoses (AFOs) in Claremont, Perth, for ankle instability, flat foot, tibialis posterior problems, ankle arthritis and foot drop. No referral needed.
- [Plantar Warts](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/plantar-warts): Plantar wart (verruca) assessment and treatment in Claremont, Perth, for adults and kids: silver nitrate, salicylic acid with padding and Falknor's needling. No referral needed.
- [NDIS & Disability](https://www.thefootstudio.com.au/ndis-podiatry): Podiatry for self-managed and plan-managed NDIS participants in Claremont, Perth: skin and nail care, orthoses, ankle foot orthoses, bracing, footwear and mobility. Reports for your plan.
